description.text: Note: The specialty is conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 15 students for Bachelor’s degree. Before applying, pls contact SICAS for the latest information. Program Introduction This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. Why choose to study this program? International Faculty Group Most lecturers of the core & distinctive courses are fluent English-speaking lecturers recruited worldwide. All lecturers have practical experience in teaching and years of experience working in the industry. In addition, renowned scholars and practitioners will be invited to give lessons or lectures. Chinese Characteristic Weifang Universityoffers more than just programs which are commonly provided in other universities. Courses, such as Chinese language, culture, and ways to do business in China are introduced to increase the competitive advantages of our students. Program Objectives To nurture qualified and skilled talents who are well-versed in Chinese language and culture, who will have a good grasp of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so as to meet the demands of the fast changing world economy.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Weifang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3. High school's degree certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
